answer: In a labor-market agent economy, each worker agent stakes a bonded credential whose crystal identity is derived from a verifiable work-history kernel rather than a self-asserted name. Sybil resistance emerges because duplicate identity claims collapse onto the same kernel, so a colluder cannot multiply voting weight without posting fresh capital per clone, making the oasis. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
